about.product: TrajectoryLab is a local scientific desktop environment for reproducible numerical studies of the translational motion of rigid spherical particles in a gaseous medium. The physics core is independent of the Qt interface and uses SI values internally.

about.details:
PHYSICAL MODEL
Rigid spherical particle; translational motion; local Cartesian coordinates; prescribed gravity field and fluid drag. Spin, lift, deformation, collisions and CFD are not modelled.

TECHNOLOGY
Python · NumPy · SciPy · Pint · Pydantic · PySide6 / Qt 6 · pyqtgraph. Integrators: RK4 and DOP853.

LOCAL DATA
Settings, user models and logs are normally stored in %USERPROFILE%\.trajectory_lab. The desktop application does not upload experiments or telemetry.

NETWORK AND SECURITY
During first setup Builder downloads Python from python.org and packages from PyPI. The application does not sandbox Python plugins: load only reviewed code. Prefer JSON/CSV models when a relationship can be represented as a table. Do not run the application as Administrator.
